Rina (CS): Vevra sent back a short vendor risk form. They want: exact embeddings retention, deletion SLA, and who holds the KMS keys for Dedicated. Renewal reminder in ~40 days — marking as moderate risk.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Can we give them a 2-line pasteable answer + an evidence link? They prefer one paragraph.
Priya (Security): Short answer: Dedicated keeps inference data and KV cache in tenant-dedicated compute in their chosen region. Embeddings default retention 90 days; configurable to 0/30/90/365. Deletion/export via support: Dedicated SLA 7 days, Hosted SLA 14 days. KMS: BYOK for Private; Dedicated uses Redwood-managed tenant keys unless BYOK enterprise integration is requested. We can provide proof-of-deletion samples and SOC2 control excerpts on request.
Tom (AE): I'll offer a 30-min technical call with their security lead this week to walk through the evidence.
evidence-bot: Evidence bundle created: `vevra-1775559999-bundle.zip` (SOC2 excerpts, KMS integration notes, sample deletion confirmation). URL: https://files.redwood.example/vevra-1775559999-bundle.zip
Rina (CS): Sending the paragraph + evidence bundle now, scheduling a call for Fri 11am PT. Will update thread after call. :calendar: :phone:
